newsitem.title: EGYPT: Dutch foreign minister in Cairo for EU talks.
newsitem.headline: Dutch foreign minister in Cairo for EU talks.

text.p: Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo arrived in Cairo on Monday for talks on the role of the European Union in the Middle East.
The presidential palace said van Mierlo would meet Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak on Tuesday and also hold talks with Foreign Minister Amr Moussa.

The Netherlands holds the rotating presidency of the 15- nation EU for the first half of this year. The bloc appointed last year a Middle East envoy to boost Europe's role in the U.S.-dominated peace negotiations in the region.
Egypt and the EU are also negotiating the final points of a joint cooperation accord which includes most southern Mediterranean countries.
